core.store.note: macOS uses the data-protection keychain where entitled; an unentitled process (an unsigned CLI) keeps the file-based keychain and storeStatus() reports legacy-keychain.

core.copy.note: SP-S13 has not landed: the generated Copy.generated.swift (COPY_CODES, COPY_GATE, COPY_ACTIVATION, COPY_FALLBACK) is read by nothing; ErrorCopy is still a hand-written table that differs from copy.en.json, with no placeholder filling.

config.resolve.note: Member names compare by scalar value, but JSONValue keeps the first of two canonically equivalent names (WIRE-CONTRACT-V3 §10).

config.mirror.note: The Swift mirror is rendered by tools/gen-mirrors.ts.

config.local.note: config.set, clear and clearAll persist through a LocalConfigStore, validate against the catalog and raise client.events .config (LocalConfigTests), but config.setting(key) and onConfigChange(key, listener) (SDK-PARITY-PASS §3.11) are missing.

devices.attest.note: client.devices.attest() (PolarisKey/DevicesClient.swift): POST devices/attest/challenge, DCAppAttestService.attestKey over SHA-256(UTF-8(requestHash)) through PolarisKeyPlatform's AppAttestClient, POST devices/attest; the key id kept in the Keychain (account app_attest_key) and re-attested with a fresh key when a reinstall, migration or restore killed it. Registered as Core's attestor so a 403 attestation_required edge-mint or commerce claim attests once and retries once. Unsupported runtime on macOS and where App Attest does not run (the simulator); outlet on an iOS build with an embedded provisioning profile.

identity.oidc.note: No OIDC redirect flow yet: native browser sign-in waits on I-15. The interim is client.identity signInWithBrowser(), which opens the device-code verification URL in ASWebAuthenticationSession and polls identity.devicecode (never the deprecated /identity/auth/poll).

identity.devicelabel.note: PX-W13: normalizeDeviceLabel over Unicode scalars, CoreOptions.deviceName and the platform default (macOS Host.current().localizedName, iOS-family UIDevice.current.name), on beginSignIn, activation and registration; SignInPrompt.deviceName is the Worker's echo. PolarisKeyUI has no device-code sign-in view to show it in (ui.kit is planned and unowned).

release.fetch.note: client.update.fetch(version:buildId:size:sha256:to:) streams and checks size and SHA-256, but has no Range/If-Range resume (release-fetch-gated.json's 206 step) and reads a 401 as download_auth_required without the body's code; it streams through URLSession directly rather than the client's transport.

update.feeds.note: client.update.feedUrl(_:channel:velopackChannel:buildId:) over updateFeedURL (PolarisKeyUpdate/Install.swift); FeedUrlMatrixTests drives every feed-url-matrix.json row.

update.content.note: PolarisKeyCore's feedContent, holdsOf (stampHolds) and decideUpdate with UpdateContentInput (selectPackRows, the composition, prestage, contentBlock, packs; bootDecision gives required only for revoked required content); runUpdateCheck runs P4-13 §2.5 steps 10–14. ContentDecisionConformanceTests drives every feedContentCases and contentRows vector; UpdateClient.decide() builds the content input from update.packs.

update.bootguard.note: PolarisKeyCore AppBootGuard (client.bootGuard, client.markBootAttempt/confirmBoot with PolarisKeyUpdate): bootGuardAction over a launch counter kept beside the credential (Store record boot-guard); an Apple app has no previous build to roll back to, so after MAX_FAILED_BOOTS it journals P6-03 boot_rolled_back (code no-previous) once and answers rollBackUnavailable; the first confirmed launch of a new build journals update_confirmed. client.boot() marks the attempt and confirms BOOT_OK_SECONDS after ready.

outlet.detect.note: PolarisKeyCore detectOutlet over PolarisKeyUpdate readOutletSignals: AppDistributor.current behind #available(iOS 17.4) (web from 17.5) raced against the 2 s deadline, AltStore's ALTBundleIdentifier, embedded.mobileprovision, the macOS _MASReceipt and ProductionSandbox, the signing leaf (SecCodeCopySigningInformation) and the product's Caskroom link. UpdateClient detects at its first decision when the host names no outlet.

crash.tags.note: No Swift crashTags() exists yet (plans/SP-00.md §5: the lead cuts a Swift task).

packs.record.note: PolarisKeyCore's verifyReleaseRecord with pin.kind (pack records fetched by the content stamp's pin) and PolarisKeyPacks' verifyMarker for embedded baselines; PackRecordConformanceTests drives every packRecordCases and markerCases vector.

packs.revoke.note: PolarisKeyCore's revocationOf, verifyRevocation and newerRevocation (every revocationCases vector); PackEngine keeps the sibling revocations.json (revocationsStored in state.json first, never created empty, re-verified per entry on load, relearn, the 256-target cap, torn and unreadable rules, recoverState clears relearn) and refuses revoked releases with pack-revoked (detail relearn for a refused baseline it cannot fetch).

packs.delegation.note: PolarisKeyCore verifyReleaseRecord (the delegated path, steps 13 and 16), verifyDelegation, recordRevoked and PolarisKeyPacks dataOnlyRefusal; the PackEngine fetches and caches delegations, refuses non-data-only delegated installs with pack-not-data-only, stores PackInstall.delegation and refuses releases under a revoked delegation (pack-revoked, detail delegation); DelegationConformanceTests drives every delegationCases and dataOnlyCases vector.

packs.plan.note: PolarisKeyPacks' plan, selectVariant and planTarget; every plan-matrix.json row, variant case and target case in PlanMatrixTests.

packs.index.files.note: PolarisKeyPacks' parseFilesIndex, checkPaths and treeDigest; filesIndexCases in ContentConformanceTests, read from the checkout.

packs.index.chunks.note: PolarisKeyPacks' parseChunkIndex and parseChunkIndexBytes (u64 from two little-endian u32 reads composed byte by byte, saturated at 2^53); chunkIndexCases in ContentConformanceTests under both libzstd paths.

packs.apply.full.note: applyFull, streamed through libzstd's ZSTD_decompressStream (and one-shot without it); applyCases under both paths.

packs.apply.file.note: applyFile with the type-neutral container rebuild; applyCases under both paths.

packs.apply.chunk.note: applyChunk (seed map, chunkRuns, repair pass, run journal resume) over chunkRangeFetch: one bounded Range per run with If-Range and Accept-Encoding identity through URLSession, an exact Content-Range and ETag, never multi-range. PackEngine keeps seed indexes under <packs root>/index/, seeds across packs and embedded baselines, and falls back on a refused range; the chunk applyCases in ContentConformanceTests and ChunkSyncTests.

packs.apply.delta.note: libzstd 1.5.7 (facebook/zstd SwiftPM package): ZSTD_DCtx_refPrefix with ZSTD_d_windowLogMax; the window check runs in the applier before every prefix decode, macOS and iOS alike.

packs.delta.feed.note: feedContent reads the feed's deltas menu (both caps, both uniqueness rules, a non-payload entry dropped alone), withFeedDeltas merges it into the selected container variant before planTarget, and PackEngine tries at most one feed-offered delta per install (fallback on a failed fetch or any delta verdict), journalling it as feedDelta for resume; UpdateClient hands PacksClient the menu of the feed each check used (fresh or stale) and reads the committed feed from the cache when the engine starts.

packs.state.note: PackEngine over DirPackStorage in the platform data directory (excluded from backups): journal, resume with Range/If-Range, atomic pointer swap with F_FULLFSYNC, confirm, rollback, GC roots, embedded baselines, a torn state.json held aside, an unreadable one refusing every write; packSetId on devices/report.

packs.handlers.note: update.packs.registerHandler (PackHandler: supports, check over a newly staged payload before the state commit -> pack-type-check-failed, activate with the installed payload, deactivate); files.tree, data.json and l10n.table built in (hot: versioned directory plus pointer swap); ml.model registered by the host; custom.* through registerHandler, under the same path rules.

packs.type.godot.zip.note: P4-16: a godot.zip is mounted only by Godot's load_resource_pack.

packs.type.l10n.table.note: P4-16: L10nTableHandler (built in): PO, CSV and JSON tables by plain parsers (L10n.swift, scanned as Unicode scalars), BCP-47 locale matched to the variant; tables(packId), onActivate/onDeactivate.

packs.type.data.json.note: P4-16: DataJsonHandler (built in): every file strict JSON (strictParse), formatVersions listed by the host; documents(packId).

packs.type.audio.bank.note: P4-16: audio banks load through a game engine's middleware.

packs.type.ml.model.note: P4-16: MlModelHandler (host-registered): model.json runtime, quantisation and RAM/VRAM needs against the host budget, then the host load test before model(packId) swaps.

packs.transport.apple.note: SP-S08: PolarisKeyUpdate's AppleAssetPackTransport (a PackPlatformTransport over P5-05's AssetPackClient, set as PacksOptions.platformTransport): the level's asset pack <pack>-c<contentApi> (dots to hyphens), files under pkey/<asset pack>/ resolved with url(for:) on every call and never persisted, ensure with progress forwarded. The engine plans a carried pack only through the platform (plan-transport-unsupported while it is unavailable, never a CDN fallback), verifies the marker and the payload or treeDigest against the signed record, floats to a later unrevoked seq, and never commits the copy to the state. Unsupported version below iOS / macOS 26.4 and outlet without the Background Assets Info.plist keys. Stub-proven in PlatformTransportTests; the TestFlight device run is the owner's, as for Godot's P5-08.

packs.transport.steam.note: P5-08 covers Godot only; macOS Swift apps have no Steam-depot transport owner.

ui.stages.note: bootTransition and the stage-matrix replay (StageMatrixTests); client.boot() drives it end to end (discover, guard, sync, keyless reacquire under an open policy, gate, decide and fetch hooks installed by PolarisKeyUpdate, mount).

ui.boot.note: client.boot() (PolarisKey/Boot.swift): with no token under an open registration policy it registers keylessly before the sync pass; boot-cold-register.json replays through it.

ui.kit.note: PolarisLoginView, PolarisGate, PolarisSignIn and PolarisOfflineActivation over the @Observable PolarisKeyModel; the rest of the kit (PARITY §5.9) belongs to the UI-kit program (UK-*).

ui.cli.note: This SDK ships a widget kit (ui.kit); the terminal kit is the headless SDKs' expectation.

commerce.receipt.note: client.commerce (PolarisKey/CommerceClient.swift): binding() and claim(store:payload:) with claimAppStore/claimSteam/claimPlay, a forced sync after a granted claim, attest-and-retry on attestation_required; purchase(productID:) runs binding, StoreKit 2 purchase(appAccountToken: bindingId), claim, finish only after the claim, sync; restore() and the Transaction.updates loop claim and finish after the claim. Without StoreKit purchase/restore answer the typed runtime N/A.
